description: Scan a remote MCP server URL (or a local MCP connector directory) for OAuth 2.1, RFC 8707 audience validation, RFC 8252 loopback redirects, OAuth metadata, scope posture, secret surface, tool manifest drift, and tool-description prompt injection patterns. Returns a letter grade, numeric score and the full findings list. Runs zero-auth probing by default (metadata-level checks only). Pass "authToken" to probe behind authentication. Pass "probeAudienceToken" to enable AUDIENCE-001 (cross-audience token check, RFC 8707). Pass "probeMissingAudToken" to enable AUDIENCE-002 (missing-aud-claim check, catches the if (aud && aud !== me) reject early-exit bug). Pass "probeDcrLoopback: true" to enable AUTH-006 (writes a throw-away client registration to the authorization server). Pass "probeHeadlessOauth: true" to enable the OAuth 2.1 conformance battery (PKCE-001 missing PKCE, PKCE-002 plain PKCE, IMPLICIT-001 implicit grant, REDIRECT-002 unregistered redirect_uri). The scanner never calls any of the server's tools.

authToken.description: Bearer token to send on every probe request. Use for servers that require authentication beyond initialize.

probeAudienceToken.description: Bearer token minted for a DIFFERENT resource on the same authorization server. Enables AUDIENCE-001 (RFC 8707 cross-audience check).

probeDcrLoopback.description: Opt into AUTH-006 active Dynamic Client Registration loopback probe (RFC 8252 Section 7.3). Writes a throw-away client to the authorization server; off by default.

probeHeadlessOauth.description: Opt into the OAuth 2.1 conformance battery (PKCE-001, PKCE-002, IMPLICIT-001, REDIRECT-002). Registers a throw-away client via DCR, then sends four crafted /authorize requests. Off by default.

probeMissingAudToken.description: Bearer token whose JWT payload has NO aud claim at all. Enables AUDIENCE-002 (catches `if (aud && aud !== me) reject` early-exit bug per RFC 9068 Section 4).

target.description: MCP server URL (https://...) or absolute path to a local connector directory.

name: audit_mcp_server
title: Audit an MCP server for OAuth 2.1 and security gaps
